subject.title: feat(workboard): bind cards to primary sessions

question: Should Workboard permanently expose session bind/rebind/detach through Gateway and agent tools, with mismatched-session mutations failing and claims auto-binding unbound cards?
rationale: This is a new operator and agent-facing contract with compatibility implications for existing Workboard automations; code review alone cannot choose its long-term API and upgrade policy.

options.title: Adopt the binding contract
options.body: Confirm the Gateway and agent-tool API plus session-aware guard behavior, then require focused real behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Limit this PR to atomic UI updates
options.body: Keep the one-request Control UI repair but remove the new external binding API and session-enforcement behavior until a scoped contract is approved.

options.title: Design the API first
options.body: Pause the PR while Workboard owners define callers, failure behavior, and documentation for session ownership and handoff.

recommendation.title: Adopt the binding contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the Gateway and agent-tool API plus session-aware guard behavior, then require focused real behavior proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the proposed Workboard API and can clarify the intended operator and agent workflows, though ownership history beyond this branch was not available in the supplied review evidence.
